title: HEAVY....but more for 'forming' burgers -not 'flat bottom'
text:
HEAVY....but more for 'forming' burgers -not 'flat bottom'. While this IS a very heavy quality iron press, I was deceived by the ad photos, as I believed it had a totally flat bottom. It does NOT! It has like a 1/3 inch 'lip", so it is "more for forming burgers" from a meat chunk(!).
I wanted something that totally pressed down my food in a frying pan....so I had to send this back

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CGPR-223 XL Cast Iron Griddle Press
features: CAST IRON CONSTRUCTION: The durable cast iron construction is perfect for retaining heat and will hold up for years to come.
COMMERCIAL XL SIZE: The 10" x 10" face of the press is ideal for pressing 6 burgers, 4 sandwiches or 2-3 pieces of steak or chicken at a time.
GRILL MARKS: Even on a griddle, this press will allow you to leave expert-looking grill marks on steak, chicken or vegetables.
HEALTHY EATING: Use the press to press out any unwanted grease and oils from your food.
description: Take your griddling and grilling game to the next level with the Cuisinart XL Cast Iron Griddle Press. The durable cast iron construction will ensure this press holds up for years to come. The commercial size press measures 10" x 10" and helps to promote even cooking and is perfect for pressing 6 burgers, 4 sandwiches or 2-3 pieces of steak or chicken at a time. Even when on a griddle, you can create expert-looking grill marks that will leave your guests wowed. The wood handle provides a stylish and comfortable grip that won't over heat when left on the cooking surface. Help encourage healthy eating by using the press to get rid of any unwanted grease or oils.
